sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Real-Time Video Matching and Cross-Border Social Telephony

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No standalone Samoan bilateral investment treaty is in force as of the knowledge cutoff; Samoa is a WTO Member (acceded 2012) and a party to the Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), which contains investment-related provisions.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2018 (Act No. 11 of 2018) as amended, ss. 10–16 (customer due diligence and beneficial ownership); International Companies Act 1987 as amended, ss. 22–27 (registered agent obligations to keep share register, directors register, and beneficial ownership records); Central Bank of Samoa AML/CFT Regulations and Directions; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2012 (as amended).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card for each proposed director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport office, civil registry, or notary public in the document holder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if country of origin is an Apostille member) or Consular Legalization by the Samoan consulate or Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address for each beneficial owner (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated bank in the beneficial owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the country of issuance and Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming financial standing and no adverse banking conduct
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank maintaining the account for the shareholder or beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank letterhead certification, notarization if required, and Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incumbency or certificate of good standing for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or licensed registered agent in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if jurisdiction of incorporation is an Apostille member) or Consular Legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, and signatories against the United Nations Security Council consolidated list, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list, European Union consolidated financial sanctions list, UK HM Treasury consolidated list, and Samoa's Central Bank/Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit domestic sanctions and watchlist. Risk-based PEP determination is required for all politically exposed persons, including family members and close associates, with mandatory enhanced due diligence and source-of-wealth documentation. Any positive match must be escalated to the registered agent's AML Compliance Officer and, where required, reported to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit as a suspicious transaction report. Given the cross-border video-chat business model with Apple IAP and Paymentwall settlement rails, second-level enhanced due diligence applies to all payment counterparties and high-volume transaction flows.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) Companies Registry – international company name reservation and search portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal name of an International Company must be in English or use a romanized/transliterated form acceptable to the Registrar. A parallel Chinese or other foreign-script name may be mentioned in the constitutional documents, but the registered legal name must be expressed in Latin script. The Registrar may require an English translation of any non-English name or document submitted for clearance.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Limited or Ltd (unless the company is in fact limited)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant, acting through the licensed registered agent, may file a written appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 30 calendar days of the date of the rejection notice. The appeal must state the legal grounds for the proposed name and, where the objection is based on a sensitive or prohibited token, must annex the written consent of the relevant minister or statutory authority. If the Registrar fails to issue a determination within 14 business days after the appeal, the applicant may seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa or submit a fresh name reservation application with revised wording. No extension of the 30-day reservation window is available, except by filing a fresh reservation and paying the prevailing name reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Samoa International Companies are not required to maintain physical operational premises; the statutory registered office may be the address of a licensed Samoan registered agent. Virtual operations and remote management from outside Samoa are permissible, and the regulator will not insist on local employees. However, for an ISIC 6311 real-time video-matching and cross-border social telephony platform, the commercial substance expectation is higher due to the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML/CFT rating: the registered agent must maintain effective control over UBO records, source-of-funds documentation, and payment-rail compliance, and the company must be able to demonstrate real decision-making by its directors.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 10% annual likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection of the registered agent's office and the company's compliance records during the first operating year. The likelihood rises to approximately 25% if the company triggers an OFAC/UN sanctions hit, files a suspicious activity report, or processes unusually high payment volumes through Apple IAP or Paymentwall in a manner that attracts regulator or correspondent-bank scrutiny.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government name reservation and International Company incorporation filing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) Companies Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: International Companies Act 1987 and applicable Companies (Fees) Regulations prevailing tariff.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and statutory registered office service fee (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoan licensed international company registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for AML-compliant registered agent services in Samoa.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization bundle for certified passport, address proof, and bank reference
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in document origin country, originating Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Samoan consulate or Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial/consular fee tariff plus actual disbursements.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT enhanced due diligence, UBO piercing, PEP screening, and OFAC/UN sanctions screening per beneficial owner
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate per enhanced due diligence file, inclusive of third-party screening tool charges.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of Memorandum and Articles of Association in English with optional parallel Chinese expression
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Professional fee at prevailing market rate of approximately USD 250 per hour; fixed fee for standard International Company constitutional documents.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of good conduct / police clearance for each ultimate beneficial owner (if required by registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Police authority or criminal records bureau in the beneficial owner's country of residence
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Host-government statutory fee plus mandatory apostille or legalization certification.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of foreign-language documents (Korean, Chinese, or other) into English and courier of original documents to Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translation agency and international courier service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing per-page translation rate and courier service actual invoice.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit registration of the registered agent's AML compliance information sheet (one-off)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit / Central Bank of Samoa

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, ss. 5–9 (Incorporation), s. 14 (Registered Office), s. 18 (Officers), s. 22 (General Powers) and Schedule 1 (Memorandum and Articles)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form 1) accompanied by the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed. The standard initial issued capital is US$1.00 represented by one ordinary share. No escrow account requirement is imposed; subscription consideration may be held in the client trust account of a licensed registered agent pending incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the subscription by the founding subscriber of one ordinary share of the Company at par in the amount of US$1.00 is hereby ratified, accepted, and the said share is allotted as fully paid. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the registered office of the Company at the offices of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa is adopted as the Company's registered office. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the appointments of the first Director and the first Company Secretary are confirmed, and the Director is authorised to open banking accounts, sign commercial agreements, and cause all incorporation filings. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the Company's constitution is adopted, and the common seal, if any, is approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Registry, MCIL, Apia (e-file via Samoa International Companies Online Portal or in-person)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search and reservation request stating the proposed company name, business purpose, and desired corporate suffix (Limited, Ltd., Corporation, or Corp.). The Registrar verifies that the name is not identical or misleadingly similar to an existing domestic or international company. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 30 days. Confirm the name in writing before proceeding.
required_dossiers: Name search and reservation application form
Certificate of clearance from the Companies Registry for the requested name
Written confirmation of the proposed company name and purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected on grounds of similarity or undesirability, a revised name may be resubmitted within the 30-day reservation window. An applicant aggrieved by a refusal may file a written appeal with the Registrar within 14 days of receipt of the refusal notice, and the Registrar will issue a written determination within 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Samoa international company service provider or Notary Public within Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with Schedule 1 of the International Companies Act 1987. Ensure that the constitution sets out the company name, registered office address, authorised share capital, subscriber details, and permitted objects. Execute the constitution before a notary public for each subscriber and director. Where the subscriber is a corporate entity, provide and attest a board resolution authorizing execution.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by each subscriber
Consent to act as Director and as Secretary (signed by each proposed officer)
Signed power of attorney if execution is made by a corporate representative or agent
Board resolution of subscriber entity authorizing execution (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a substantive defect in the constitution, the drafting attorney shall revise the document and obtain fresh signatures. Any error in the Director's or Secretary's consent may be cured by filing a corrected consent before submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Registry, Apia or approved online filing portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company) together with the notarized constitution and a statutory declaration of compliance signed by the subscriber or its authorised agent. Pay the official filing fee of USD 150 and any applicable service fees. Ensure the application names the initial registered office and proposes the first directors and secretary. Retain a stamped receipt for post-incorporation registration.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Official fee payment receipt (bank transfer or registry cashier receipt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar raises a deficiency objection or requisition, the applicant or licensed agent must cure each item within 21 days of written notice. A formal response to the query is submitted with supporting documents; if amendment is required, the applicant may file a supplemental declaration and re-submit destroyed or deficient documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of all statutory requirements, the Registrar assigns a unique company registration number, signs and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The company comes into existence as a body corporate on the date stated in the certificate. The registered agent must verify the certificate details and retain the original in the company file.
required_dossiers: Company number confirmation generated by the registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains typographical errors, the company may submit a written rectification request and the original certificate to the Registrar for correction under section 47 of the Act. The correction is issued within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Registered Office and Officer Notices
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and Company Secretary for Samoa International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 21 days of incorporation, file Form 6 (Notice of Registered Office) and Form 7 (Notice of Directors and Secretary) with the Registrar. Hold the first board meeting either physically or by written resolution to approve share allotment, adopt the constitution, confirm officers, and authorise banking. Update the registered office with the licensed agent's physical address in Samoa.
required_dossiers: Form 6 (Notice of Registered Office) completed by the registered agent
Minutes of first board meeting or written resolution
Consent to act forms executed by the director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notice forms are rejected for incompleteness, the registered agent must correct and resubmit within 21 days. Late filing of Forms 6 and 7 may be cured by payment of the prescribed late filing fee and submission of a corrective cover letter explaining the delay.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no physical industrial operation or manufacturing facility is established under this digital service business
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no statutory operating or manufacturing permit required for a purely digital real-time video matching application

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment and Conservation Division, Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category 5 (Digital/Information Services) having no land use, discharge, or emissions trigger under the Samoa Planning and Urban Management Act and EIA Regulations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or solid waste generation from the core service. Incidental office activity, if any, must comply with the Samoa Ambient Water Quality Standards for discharge to sewer or aquatic receptors and the Waste Management Regulations; all waste must be disposed of by licensed waste carriers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable at formation stage as no local physical premises are required. If a Samoan branch office is later established, the operator must obtain a fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority, pass structural load inspection under the Works Regulation 2014, and obtain an occupancy clearance from the National Building Inspectorate.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue, Samoa (MaF) — official portal: Samoa Revenue Online Services (SROS) at https://eservice.revenue.gov.ws; primary website: https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 2012 through the Registrar of International Companies in the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, using a licensed offshore service provider/registered agent in Samoa. Step 2: Submit a Tax Identification Number (TIN) application (Form IR-01 'Application for Registration for Tax Purposes') to the Ministry for Revenue, either physically at the VAGST/Income Tax Unit or via MRS e-services at https://eservice.revenue.gov.ws. Step 3: Attach certified copies of: Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association (constitutional documents), registered agent address certificate, directors/shareholders name, address, nationality details, and a declaration that no business is carried on within Samoa. Step 4: The Ministry for Revenue issues a 9-digit TIN within 3–5 working days. If the IC elects to claim VAGST refunds or to employ local staff, it must in addition register for VAGST and PAYE through the same portal. Foreign-incorporated entities seeking to do business in Samoa would instead register an external branch with the Registrar of Companies and obtain a TIN on the same Form IR-01.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: Samoa International Company is statutorily exempt from all Samoan income tax, stamp duty, and VAGST on its worldwide offshore operations while it has no Samoa-resident members, carries on no business in Samoa, and holds no Samoan real property (International Companies Act 2012, s.7 exemption). It is classified as a non-resident company with no Samoan-source income; territorial scope is offshore-only; income tax applies only if the IC elects or is treated as a local company (or breaches the exemption conditions), in which case it becomes taxable on Samoan-source income at 27% corporate rate (standard rate 25% plus the 2% Additional Assigned Services/SSP levy — note: headline corporate tax rate in Samoa is 25%; the AASP levy may apply).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), Apia, Samoa, acting under the Exchange Control Act and delegated authorization to licensed commercial banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) is not freely convertible outside Samoa and the offshore WST market is illiquid. Current-account transactions are generally handled through authorized dealer banks subject to documentary support and exchange-control limits; capital-account transactions, including shareholder capital injections and repatriation of funds, require central-bank approval or delegated approval. A tax-exempt Samoa International Company may maintain foreign-currency accounts and pay profits/dividends only after verification of source of funds, updated statutory records, and, where applicable, tax and registry clearance are filed with the bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory default: export proceeds must be repatriated through a Samoan licensed bank and surrendered/converted into WST no later than 90 days from shipment or invoice date. The mandatory conversion ratio is 100% unless the Central Bank of Samoa grants a foreign-currency retention account approval or an explicit exemption for a service exporter such as the ISIC 6311 video-matching application where offshore platform receipts are channeled through aggregators. Any conversion exemption should be documented as a CBS retention direction to avoid penalty.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: US Dollar and Samoa Tala Operational Accounts; Trade Clearing and FX Settlement Account
WST Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for local WST clearing because offshore electronic-money institutions (EMIs) are not licensed by the Central Bank of Samoa and cannot access the domestic WST clearing system. An offshore EMI may serve only as an auxiliary USD/EUR payout channel for platform receipts, provided the Samoa entity retains a licensed commercial bank for all WST conversion, exchange-control reporting, and repatriation flows. There is no Samoa EMI license class, and use of an unlicensed overseas EMI as primary settlement rails will create an AML/fintech compliance blocker.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for at least one director, authorized signatory, or appointed agent with board-authorized power of attorney during initial account opening at a Samoan bank. Remote-only onboarding is generally not accepted for International Companies; the bank will require an in-person interview, original board resolution, certified passports, proof of residential address for all twenty-five percent or more beneficial owners, and a wet-signature account mandate. Correspondent-bank due diligence also requires local banker validation of the entity and its principals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with non-resident tax-exempt status and no physical office in Samoa
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the current International Companies Act registration certificate and certified registry extracts, registered agent letter confirming the registered office, beneficial ownership register, company constitution, notarized and apostilled passports of directors and shareholders, professional references, source-of-wealth documentation, and a substance statement explaining the video-matching platform's operating location.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border consumer payments from app-store aggregators (Apple IAP and Paymentwall) in a medium-risk social telephony sector
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit executed Apple and Paymentwall merchant agreements, app descriptions and content-moderation policy, expected monthly transaction values and jurisdictions, transaction-flow diagrams, sanctions and adverse-media screening results, customer terms of service, refund and anti-fraud policies, and the entity's AML/CTF program with transaction monitoring and SAR escalation procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International fund movement for shareholder capital injection and ongoing foreign-currency receivables
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare board resolutions authorizing capital injection, updated share register and share certificates, bank-source-of-funds proof, any loan or subordination agreement if funds are intercompany debt, anticipated settlement statement from Apple IAP and Paymentwall, and the Central Bank of Samoa exchange-control application where the transaction exceeds delegated bank limits.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound injections must be routed by wire (SWIFT MT103 with gpi) to the Samoa IC's licensed commercial bank account. Beneficiary field must show the Samoa IC name exactly as registered; remittance information should identify 'capital contribution / shareholder subscription' and the ISIC 6311 development purpose. The receiving bank will require the corporate KYC pack, source of funds, capitalization resolution, updated register of members, and a written explanation of the non-resident status. If the remittance is in USD and WST conversion is required, the bank will quote against WST and, depending on amount, obtain delegated exchange-control approval. No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies for the International Company, but the bank may set a minimum opening deposit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound vendor, cloud infrastructure, marketing, and licensing payments are settled through the licensed bank's SWIFT network using MT103 for direct remittances or MT700 documentary credit for larger structured trade. Samoa does not operate a local USD real-time gross settlement; Samoan bank USD is drawn through foreign correspondent banks in the United States, Australia, New Zealand, and Europe. Export invoices, service contracts, platform cost statements, and exchange-control forms must be retained to support the purpose of every outward transfer. For app-related disbursements to payment aggregators, net settlement statements from Apple IAP and Paymentwall are the governing clearing documents.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable forward foreign-exchange contract (USD/WST) with a licensed Samoan commercial bank, available up to 12 months and supported by documented platform revenue and cost exposure
Cross-currency swap transaction with a licensed bank under delegated exchange-control approval, where a genuine capital and operational currency mismatch exists
Non-deliverable-forward contract for WST/USD arranged offshore only with prior written approval of the Central Bank of Samoa; speculative trading in futures or options is not permissible

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, Registrar of International Companies (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the company's registration anniversary; filings submitted within the 60-day grace period after the anniversary are deemed current
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties accrue after the 60-day grace period: 10% of the annual fee for filings made between day 61 and day 90; 50% for filings made between day 91 and the end of month 6; after 6 months of non-renewal the Registrar may initiate strike-off, leading to dissolution and loss of legal personality

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, submitted concurrently with the Annual Renewal Application on or before the registration anniversary; any change in beneficial ownership or registrable particulars must be updated within 14 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing blocks the renewal of the company's certificate of incorporation; knowingly providing false or misleading beneficial ownership information constitutes an offence punishable by a fine of up to WST 10,000 and/or imprisonment, and the Registrar may strike off the company for continued non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not applicable - an International Company carrying on a non-licensed digital platform business is exempt from operating licence requirements under the International Companies Act 2007

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None - Samoa International Companies are exempt from mandatory statutory audit regardless of size or turnover, unless the company's memorandum or articles mandate an audit, or the Registrar/Court orders an examination of accounts under the International Companies Act 2007
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory filing framework; books may be kept under IFRS, Samoan equivalent GAAP, or a reasonable alternative basis consistent with the size of the company

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, the International Company must confirm the accuracy of its register of beneficial owners and file updated UBO declarations with the Registry at the time of the Annual Renewal Application; share transfers must be recorded in the UBO register within 14 days and reflected in the next annual confirmation. Companies listed on a recognised stock exchange or holding a regulated activity licence may apply for an exemption.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; USD 2,500 - 5,000 if an independent certified audit is voluntarily commissioned

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Samoa International Company; standard resident-company headline rate 27%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 100% offshore exemption for International Companies under the International Companies Act 1988 and Income Tax Act 2017. The entity is exempt from Samoa income tax, capital gains tax and stamp duty on non-Samoa-source income; no minimum capital; no tax on distributions. The exemption is conditional on non-resident shareholding, no Samoa-source revenue, no insurance/reinsurance against Samoa risks, no carrying on business in Samoa through a fixed establishment, and no Samoa land ownership.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: SIFSA Annual Return (international company annual filing) filed electronically by the licensed registered agent in the SIFSA Online Agent Portal. No Samoa Inland Revenue income tax return is due for a compliant tax-exempt International Company.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be filed no later than the end of the statutory anniversary month of incorporation, or within 30 days after the annual fiscal year-end elected in the constitutive documents (usually 31 December; thus no later than 31 March).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered legal name of the International Company exactly as shown on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the legal English name only; no data field for a Chinese commercial name is required by Samoa law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International Company registration number issued by SIFSA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain the IC/CSL prefix and confirm it matches the certificate filed by the licensed agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not enter the operational headquarters in China or elsewhere; only the Samoa agent's office address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal place of business or operational headquarters, if any, outside Samoa (video-match app operating entity, data servers, and central management and control location).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the actual foreign operational address; failing to disclose real management location is a red flag for sham substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, secretary, and registered shareholders/ultimate beneficial owners, including percentage holdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide beneficial owners' foreign passport/residence details; nominee directors must also be shown and should hold a current nominee services contract in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of continued tax-exempt status and compliance with the International Companies Act restrictions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm no Samoa-source customers, no Samoa land, no Samoa fixed place of business and no revenue from Samoa residents; this declaration supports the zero withholding structure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, including class of shares and consideration paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State capital in USD or WST; flagged if capital appears artificially low relative to app revenue or if bearer shares are used.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment schedule for the annual government fee and the annual return declaration fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident owner must ensure the registered agent has funds before deadline; late fees trigger automatic penalty.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the SIFSA annual return attracts a late-payment penalty computed on the annual fee (generally 10% of the fee, with further escalating late fees each month of default); continued non-filing leads to strike-off and deregistration by the Registrar of International Companies, removal of the licensed agent and restoration costs. If the IC wrongly becomes a Samoa tax resident or derives Samoa-source income, an income tax return must be filed; late filing then attracts a 5% shortfall penalty plus monthly interest at approximately 2% and default assessments by the Samoa Inland Revenue.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends/distributions paid by a tax-exempt Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders. The generic Samoa non-resident dividend withholding tax rate is 15% where the dividend is paid by a Samoa-resident taxable company and sourced in Samoa.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Treaty relief is processed through the Samoa Inland Revenue and the foreign treaty counterparty (where a DTA is in force). The beneficial owner must obtain and file a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from Samoa Inland Revenue or the foreign competent authority, complete the relevant beneficial ownership declaration, and submit it to the withholding agent before payment. Because the International Company's distributions are statutorily exempt, no treaty claim is required for a standard IC dividend. For any taxable Samoa-source royalties/interest, a TRC plus DTA-specific clause by clause analysis must be lodged with the Inland Revenue to obtain a reduced rate; refund claims must generally be made within three years of the tax year of overpayment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoa rate is 15% on royalties and 15% on interest when paid by a Samoa-resident taxable person and sourced in Samoa; royalties/interest paid by an exempt International Company to non-residents are 0%. Limited DTA network may reduce the 15% to a lower rate for residents of the treaty jurisdiction (usually 0-10%, depending on beneficial ownership and the specific DTA).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 aggregate related-party cross-border transactions (recommended documentation threshold and standard commercial benchmark; Samoa's Income Tax Act does not prescribe a separate numeric local-file threshold in the public regulations). For a tax-exempt IC no Master File or Local File is statutorily due; nevertheless, any Samoan tax audit or economic substance review will require documentation demonstrating arm's length pricing of app IP, marketing, and intra-group service fees.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR), administered by SIFSA, apply to International Companies conducting 'relevant activities' (including IP holding, service centre, distribution/headquarters, financing, and related licensing businesses). A video-match social app that owns the proprietary platform, user data, or branding and receives the corresponding revenue streams through Samoa is expected to satisfy management and control, employee, and physical-asset substance tests in Samoa, or to prove tax residence/exclusion in a reputable foreign jurisdiction with equivalent substance. Submission of the annual economic substance declaration/return is mandatory; zero revenue or blank declarations are not accepted as compliance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying or failing to file the exemption declaration; deliberately characterising video-match subscription and in-app purchase revenue derived from Samoa users or from a Samoa PE to avoid the 27% company tax; concealing revenue streams collected through Apple IAP and Paymentwall; using backdated nominee agreements to evade information reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional assessment of the tax shortfall, shortfall penalty of up to 150% of the unpaid tax, late payment interest, and criminal conviction. Samoa criminal law provides for fines up to WST 1,000,000 for corporate offenders and imprisonment up to 7 years for knowing tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, shadow directors and beneficial owners who knowingly sign false declarations or divert revenue are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax and civil penalties; the court may impose travel bans, asset freezing orders and confiscation, and individual imprisonment of up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company and sham corporate substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Samoa International Company as a pure mailbox structure with no directors' meetings, no operational function, and no employees; hiding control by Chinese principals through nominee directors; commingling app payments with personal accounts; failing to disclose real beneficial ownership to the licensed agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and deregistration by the Registrar; disqualification of the directors and agent; monetary penalty under the International Companies Act and ESR for false substance declarations; transactions may be recharacterised by the Inland Revenue as taxable in Samoa and in the jurisdiction of effective management.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution of assets transferred out of the insolvent structure, personal liability for company debts incurred under a struck-off or sham entity, travel bans pending investigation, and disqualification from acting as director for up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the video-match app with unidentified users and unverified payment sources; ignoring transaction monitoring of Apple IAP/Paymentwall chargebacks and refund fraud; processing payments on behalf of third-party content providers without KYC; structuring crypto or wire transfers to avoid SIFSA/AML thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Samoa's Money Laundering Prevention Act and AML/CFT amendments, fines for licensed agents and reporting entities up to WST 1,000,000, confiscation of proceeds, suspension or revocation of the financial services licence, and criminal prosecution of responsible officers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face individual criminal liability, civil penalties, asset confiscation, travel bans and imprisonment of up to 14 years for money laundering or wilful blindness.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer pricing manipulation and false economic substance certification
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Executing inflated royalty or licence payments to an affiliated ad-tech/BVI entity without actual functions, assets, or risk-taking; failing to conduct a benchmarking analysis for the app's intercompany service fees; submitting a falsified ESR declaration claiming staff and premises in Samoa that do not exist; structuring the ownership chain to enable round-tripping of revenue from China.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment on an arm's length basis; disallowance of the inflated expense; shortfall penalty up to 150%; ESR administrative penalty per relevant activity; strike-off of the IC; in severe cases criminal charges for false documents under Samoa's Crimes Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally accountable for false ESR/TCR certifications; where a director causes or permits the mispricing, courts may order civil restitution, impose a travel ban, disallow the corporate veil, and impose imprisonment of up to 7 years for fraudulent documents.
